ground_rules:
LLC ground rules (Combo Fighter and whatever else we take)
This is the lifestyle route I posted about in #executives. The LLC is the new one Blake and I are setting up for the three of us, and anything Harmony Games owns (the games with their art and listings, and the equipment) comes to it only through Sunset's sale, the way I wrote after the call on Wednesday. Services we keep running just move their billing to the LLC.
The plan runs March 1 to May 31.
Domino Delights and Zombie Match come over only if what each made in January, going by the warehouse's daily revenue table, covers what its own hosting bills now, whatever we said about them before. Combo Fighter comes over either way, it's the reason we're doing this. A game that comes over brings what it needs to keep running, its accounts and its player support.
Cost every item at what it bills now, going by whoever runs it, not by what HG used to pay.
What we already decided to keep or cancel for the shutdown in #winddown stays decided.
Pay for anyone who stays on is a separate conversation once we know the running cost; this plan is only what bills us every month, no one-offs or yearly fees.
How things move is on the LLC card on our board.
project_desc: One issue per thing the LLC might take from HG or pay for. Leave your call on each one as a comment and move it: to Done if one of us pays it himself through May (even if HG still owns it) or if the LLC takes it and nothing is left to do on it; to Todo if the LLC takes it and something is still to do, and assign whoever moves it; to Canceled if it stays with HG.
trello_desc: Robert makes the call on each item in the Linear project. Whoever runs an item today moves it. Anything that comes through Sunset's sale moves when the sale closes. Anything that already has its own deadline keeps it; everything else moves by March 1.
split_mail: how we split it: each of the three of us carries a third of what the LLC costs a month, March through May. that's everything on the plan that bills monthly, including what one of us already pays for it. whatever one of us already pays personally counts toward his third, and he puts the difference in as cash. put the three shares on the sheet per month.
monday_desc: Robert's plan sheet. We agree what we take and the shares.
